_about: The fixed vocabularies the archive's readable copy turns into words. contract/DATA-CONTRACT.md 8.2 and issue #328. A stored value is not display text: a bill printed 'paid' and a project printed 'needs_attention', which are column contents rather than words, and they read the same in every language because there was nothing to translate. Each value here has a word in all four catalogs under archive.vocabulary.<name>.<value>, and check_readable_labels.py fails the build when one is missing. Where the schema constrains a column, this file must list exactly what the CHECK allows, and that check runs too, so a value added to the schema cannot quietly reach a page as itself. Which column uses which vocabulary is stated in contract/readable-fields.json, not here, because that is where every other rendering decision lives.

advice_risk.what: How cautiously the app words anything about this measure, carried from the preset.
advice_risk.source: CHECK constraint on measure.advice_risk in contract/schema.sql.

gap_tolerance.what: How far apart readings may sit before the gap is worth showing. Written by the shipped templates in templates/data/progress-and-instructions.json, which is why the schema does not constrain it.
gap_tolerance.source: Declared here. The schema does not constrain this column.

link_relation.source: Declared here. The schema does not constrain this column.
